pirs.title: TidöPakten legislative cohesion under election pressure
pirs.findings: 6 simultaneous committee battles test coalition cohesion. JuU criminal age vote is highest-risk fracture point (SD discipline uncertain). MJU permitting authority likely to be accommodated with S. NU energy bills face S+MP+C alignment.
forward_indicators: SD whip statement on criminal age

pirs.title: S coalition-building and opposition bloc formation
pirs.findings: S+MP+C energy alignment is strongest cross-party pattern in 2026 Riksdag session. S filed motions on all 6 clusters demonstrating breadth. No formal joint motions — strategic fragmentation preserved.
forward_indicators: coalition formation signals in party communications

pirs.title: Sweden energy transition policy trajectory
pirs.findings: Municipal veto reform demanded by S/MP/C; government's prop. 239 seen as insufficient. SD blocking dynamic from 2021/22 historically documented. If post-election S-led govt forms, faster wind reform highly probable.

pirs.title: Criminal justice reform and gang crime response
pirs.findings: S draws firm line at age 14 vs government's 13. ECHR risk real. JuU vote is decisive test of governing majority on flagship crime policy.

pirs.title: Environmental governance and permitting
pirs.findings: Prop. 238 new permitting authority contested by all 4 opposition parties on different grounds. V demands rejection; S demands modifications; MP demands broader mandate; C demands municipality-friendliness.
forward_indicators: government engagement with S on transition terms

pirs.title: Election 2026 campaign positioning
pirs.findings: All 16 active motions carry EP1.5 electoral proximity multiplier (132 days to election). S, MP, C, V all positioning through this motion wave. Criminal age is highest-salience electoral issue.
forward_indicators: party leader statements on key motion themes

pirs.title: Nordic and EU comparative alignment
pirs.findings: Denmark 2010 criminal age reform (14 years) = closest Nordic parallel to current debate. Sweden's proposed 13 would be below Denmark's controversial 2010 level. Energy: Sweden is outlier in maintaining full municipal wind veto vs EU peers.
